name: Signs of the Times Pamphlet
description: This pamphlet lists 300+ signs of the times from the LDS scriptures in chronological order including most of the associated scriptures. It uses the Book of Revelation as a base and merges all the other scriptures in trying to keep the events in the order they are mentioned by each prophet.

name: Signs of the Times Chart
description: This chart shows 129 prophecies in relationship to the church, the house of Israel, and the world in general.  A concise overview of the times we are living in and the signs of the second coming of Jesus Christ.  Laminated.

name: Missionary Pack (9 bookmarks)

description: This 8.5" x 11" Chart combines the prophecies about the American Indians into one concice chart.  Who are they?  Prophecies of the gentiles coming.  Why were they destroyed as a people?  What is their future?  Laminated.

description: A 8.5" x 11" chart showing the plan of salvation with a time line of the major events of this earth.  The back contains the associated scripture references.  Laminated.

name: Church History Study Map Bookmark
description: A 4.75" x 7" map of the United States with locations and events that transpired as church history unfolded.  It shows where each section of the D&C was recieved. The back has the chronology of the early church history.  Laminated.

name: Evidences for Joseph Smith Bookmark

name: Yard Signs of Jesus
description: 10 beautiful 12" x 18" yard signs with H-stakes showing images of Jesus. Great for showing your love for Jesus Christ at Christmas, Easter, or anytime.  ($15 per sign)

name: Articles of Faith Memorization Game

description: Play "Fish" using pictures of events that transpired in the Book of Mormon.  Teaches names of characters in the Book of Mormon and events.  Cards are UV coated for durability.

name: The Frugal Family Game
description: Players are each given a dollar and watch it dwindle as the lights are left on, food is wasted, water bills rise, possessions are not taken care of, etc.  Helps family members learn that money is either saved or wasted depending on the choices they make.  Comes with eight pawns.  Laminated.

description: Shows many evidences why Joseph Smith was a prophet and why the Book of Mormon is a true book of scripture.  One side shows the evidences for Joseph Smith and the other shows evidences for the Book of Mormon. Great teaching chart for Sunday School, Seminary, and Family Home Evening. Can be used as a placemat to strengthen faith every morning.  Laminated.

name: Introduction to the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints Bookmark
description: This bookmark is designed as a pass along card to share LDS beliefs with those who would like to know more about the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Laminated.

name: Introduction to the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints 10-pack
description: These cards are designed to share LDS beliefs with those who would like to know more about the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. Pack of 10 cards to leave out on your desk or wherever those interested can find them or pass along to someone who might be interested.  Laminated.

name: 2500 Signs of the Times in Chronological Order ebook
description: This book gives a comprehensive list of scriptures about future events. It takes Revelation, Mathew 24, Luke 20, and JS Mathew as a skeleton and adds in all the other references attempting to keep them in the order given in each chapter. Great for a deep dive into the Signs of Christ's coming.

name: Ri Conquers the Multiverse ebook
description: Follow a young intelligence as he learns and grows while moving through worlds of his progression. A little "coming of age", a little "a boy and his dog" and a little romance. "Ri Conquers the Multiverse" will change your view your life.

name: Deep State in the Book of Mormon
description: The Deep State, Secret Combinations, is talked about more in the Book of Mormon than America being a choice land. Why did Moroni warn us of this threat? How can we identify them?

name: Images of Jesus Coloring Book
description: Coloring book with 20 pictures and titles of Jesus. 8.5" x 11"

name: Picture Puzzle
description: 10 pictures of Jesus with small snips from the pictures to match with the pictures, with three levels of dificulty.

name: Getting Satan Out of Your Marriage Pamphlet
description: Shouldn't marital problems be solved through the gospel of Jesus Christ? How much of the conflict comes from not being Christ-like? This is a two week program to catapult your relationship from frustrating to fantastic.

name: Criticism to Gratitude Tracker Chart
description: How happy can you be? Non-judgmental, non-critical, forgiving, and grateful make for a happy marriage and life. This is a chart for helping move your life to amazing. "whoso is happy, will be happy still…." --Mormon 9:14

name: Fill a Spirit Ward
description: A ward challenge. Can you do the temple work for enough people to fill a spirit world chapel? Add a dot for each ordinance done and see their chapel fill.
